concept: premium industrial engineering, compatible with the VERTEX ecosystem but independently releasable

primary_screens.purpose: portfolio status, active sites, incidents, maintenance due, compliance expiry and financial snapshot
project lifecycle, schedule, budget, estimate, procurement, installation progress, QA/QC and handover
sales/specification pipeline plus installed-base registry, Safe Lift status, commissioning and service history
ventilation/heating/AC design workflow, equipment schedule, drawings, estimate, installation and commissioning
preventive maintenance calendar, emergency work orders, technician dispatch and SLA
licenses, specialist certificates, inspections, expiry alerts and project compliance packs

ui_rules: Use sand as a VERTEX family accent, not as the only surface color.
Technical data must remain legible before decorative styling.
Every asset card exposes status, location, model/serial, next service and compliance state.
Third-party brand references display a Reference label unless a commercial relationship is separately verified.
Red is reserved for incidents, failed inspection or expired compliance only.
